fields.title: Column selection
fields.description: Choose the column for which the string distance is defined.
fields.choicesNote: варианты появятся, когда к узлу подключена входная таблица

fields.title: Distance selection
fields.description: Select the distance measure to use for comparing strings.

fields.title: Winkler threshold
fields.description:
The modification proposed by Winkler reduces the distance between strings that have a common prefix. This
threshold controls at which Jaro similarity the Winkler modification is applied. A threshold of 0 will
always apply the modification while a threshold of 1 will never apply the modification resulting in the
Jaro distance. Our default of 0.7 is chosen to match the threshold in the python package textdistance.

fields.title: Prefix weight
fields.description: The weight with which Winkler's prefix modification changes the Jaro similarity.

fields.title: Max prefix length
fields.description:
The maximal length of a common prefix to consider (4 by default). Common prefix longer than this value
will only affect the Jaro similarity up to this length.

fields.title: Case sensitive
fields.description:
If checked, the distance considers upper and lower case characters to be different i.e. "A" and "a" are
not considered to be the same.

fields.title: Deletion weight
fields.description: The deletions are weighted according to the given value.

fields.title: Insertion weight
fields.description: The insertions are weighted according to the given value.

fields.title: Exchange weight
fields.description: The exchanges are weighted according to the given value.

fields.title: Normalize distance
fields.description: The resulting distance is in the range [0,1].

fields.title: Uppercase input
fields.description:
Transform all characters to uppercase before computing the distance. For performance issues it is
preferable to uppercase the input in a precomputation step instead of checking this option.

fields.title: Gram size
fields.description: Determines the number of contiguous items per gram.

fields.title: Tversky index
fields.description:
Select a predefined Tversky index with specific alpha and beta parameters. Selecting a predefined index
will override any custom alpha and beta values.

fields.title: Alpha
fields.description: The Tversky alpha parameter. Must be non-negative.

fields.title: Beta
fields.description: The Tversky beta parameter. Must be non-negative.

fields.title: Uppercase input
fields.description:
Transform all characters to uppercase before computing the distance. For performance reasons it is
preferable to convert the input to uppercase in a preprocessing step instead of using this option.
